These unmodified official Mojang version JSON fixtures were retrieved from the
URLs for 1.20.1 and 1.6.4 in:
https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json

They cover both standalone modern Windows native artifacts and the older
classifier/extract convention. Tests never download game binaries. Local HTTP
fixtures test successful downloads, integrity failures, repair and offline reuse.
